content: Aditya Singh discusses insurance quote options with agent Suresh Deshmukh and decides to go with the Premium Plus plan. Suresh provides details regarding the $1,200 annual deductible, specialist pre-authorization requirements, the renewal deadline of October 1, 2026, and a 10% OPD copay. Aditya asks how to submit acceptance, and Suresh instructs him to reply with "Accept Premium Plus" to process the renewal.

action_items: Customer to reply with "Accept Premium Plus" to confirm renewal
Agent to process the renewal and send updated policy document
